summary: Round 14 Part 2 Super Admin tested end-to-end (backend pytest 20 cases + 6 Playwright UI flows) plus Part 1 regression. All 5 requested fixes verified working (blank-ref reject with no side-effects, trial14 with missing/naive trial_ends, expiring_7d excludes no-end-date, explicit lift_suspension + audit, trial14 courtesy on expired paid / refused on active paid, CSV UTF-8 BOM, ConfigDialog re-inits correctly when switching orgs). FOUND & FIXED one CRITICAL frontend crash: Layout.jsx used <Button> without importing it -> 'Button is not defined' runtime error blew up the whole app whenever SupportBanner (support view) or LockGate (suspended / expired>7d) rendered. After the 1-line import fix, support view, lock screen, suspended screen all work. One remaining backend bug: naive (no-timezone) stored dates crash status_of -> 500 on /api/super/orgs, /api/super/overview and every request of that org's users; extend 'month/year/days' also 500s on naive subscription_ends.

critical.endpoint: GET /api/super/orgs, GET /api/super/overview (and get_current_user for that org's users)
critical.issue: business._days_left() does datetime.fromisoformat(iso) - datetime.now(timezone.utc); if any business has a naive trial_ends/subscription_ends (e.g. '2026-12-01T00:00:00') -> TypeError 'can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes' -> 500. One bad row breaks the entire Super Admin org list/overview. Fix: use parse_dt() in _days_left (and compare with parse_dt instead of raw string compare in _status).
extend_subscription() uses datetime.fromisoformat(b['subscription_ends']) then max() with aware now -> 500 when subscription_ends is naive. Fix 2 only made trial14 safe. Use parse_dt() here too.

minor.issue: Active/trial check is a lexicographic string compare (b['subscription_ends'] > now_iso()); fragile for naive/'Z' formats - use parse_dt.
Editing a multi-tier plan rewrites users_label from '3 to 8 users' to 'Up to 8 users' (cosmetic label drift).
Expired trial orgs show raw plan key 'trial' (lowercase) in 'Current plan' column instead of 'Free Trial (expired)'.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: missing `import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'` caused full-app runtime crash 'Button is not defined' on support view and locked/suspended screens.

integration_issues.issue: Unhandled promise rejections 'Request failed with status code 423' (4x) from data fetches behind the lock screen - harmless but noisy; catch 423 in api interceptor.

issues: Top PlanBanner still says 'Books are read-only for 7 days, then locked until you renew' while the body says grace has ended - contradictory; hide/adjust banner when locked.
Sidebar still shows 'Super Admin' link which just redirects to '/' while in support view.
No empty-state row when filters return 0 organizations (just a bare header).

action_items: Use parse_dt() in business._days_left, business._status and business.extend_subscription so naive/Z ISO dates never 500 (tests test_orgs_list_survives_naive_trial_ends, test_year_extend_naive_subscription_ends currently fail)
Keep the Button import added to /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx
Hide 'read-only for 7 days' PlanBanner on lock screen; handle 423 in axios interceptor; show 'Free Trial (expired)' instead of raw 'trial' plan label
Optional: hide Super Admin nav link during support view; empty state for org table
critical_code_review_comments: Date handling is inconsistent: parse_dt exists but _days_left/_status/extend_subscription still use raw fromisoformat/string compares.
Custom plans deleted from plan_settings stay in in-memory PLANS until backend restart (no delete endpoint; fine but note for ops).
load_plan_overrides mutates module-level PLANS - multi-worker deployments would diverge until restart.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after the Layout import fix (was crashing for support view & lock screens)
